experiences.name: W Trek Multi-Day Hike
experiences.description: Embark on the iconic W Trek, a 4-5 day trekking route through Torres del Paine National Park covering the Valle del Francés, Grey Glacier, and the iconic Torres viewpoint. Book refugios or campsites in advance. Given the late Day 1 arrival, begin the trek on Day 2 after a morning gear check and early park entry to maximize daylight hours on trail.
experiences.best_time_of_day: Early Morning (start by 07:00 to maximize daylight and avoid afternoon winds)
experiences.location: Torres del Paine National Park, Magallanes Region

experiences.name: Mirador Las Torres Sunrise Hike
experiences.description: Hike to the iconic granite towers viewpoint at sunrise for breathtaking golden-hour light on the Paine Massif. The trail starts from Hostería Las Torres and takes approximately 4-5 hours round trip. Schedule this for Day 3 or later once acclimatized, departing at 05:30 to catch the sunrise glow. Avoid scheduling on Day 1 due to late flight arrival.
experiences.best_time_of_day: Pre-Dawn to Morning (depart 05:30, arrive viewpoint by sunrise ~08:00)
experiences.location: Sector Las Torres, Torres del Paine National Park

experiences.name: Grey Glacier Trek and Kayaking
experiences.description: Trek along the shores of Lago Grey to witness the massive Grey Glacier up close, then join a guided kayaking excursion among floating icebergs. This full-day adventure combines trekking and paddling in one of Patagonia's most dramatic glacial landscapes. Best scheduled mid-trip when energy levels are still high and weather windows are favorable.
experiences.best_time_of_day: Morning to Afternoon (09:00–17:00 for calmer winds and best glacier light)
experiences.location: Lago Grey, Western Sector, Torres del Paine National Park

experiences.name: Valle del Francés Full-Day Trek
experiences.description: Hike through the stunning Valle del Francés, a glacially carved valley flanked by hanging glaciers, condor nesting cliffs, and dramatic peaks including Paine Grande and Cuerno Principal. The trail offers some of the most diverse and awe-inspiring scenery in all of Patagonia. Plan this as a full-day excursion with a packed lunch from your refugio.
experiences.best_time_of_day: Early Morning (depart 07:00 to complete the valley loop before afternoon winds pick up)
experiences.location: Valle del Francés, Central Sector, Torres del Paine National Park

experiences.name: Puma and Wildlife Tracking Guided Safari
experiences.description: Join a specialist naturalist guide for a half-day wildlife tracking experience in the open pampas of Torres del Paine, searching for pumas, guanacos, Andean condors, and rheas. This low-impact activity is ideal for a rest day between major treks and can be scheduled on Day 2 after the late Day 1 arrival to ease into the trip without overexertion.
experiences.best_time_of_day: Early Morning or Late Afternoon (06:00–09:00 or 17:00–20:00 when pumas are most active)
experiences.location: Laguna Amarga and Pampas Sector, Torres del Paine National Park
